version_note: v66: runtime-only reseal after the v65 verified liquidation reconciliation. The hourly producer now recognizes a separately sealed direct executor receipt for the exact inference bundle and decision hour, so a service restart waits for the next candle instead of retrying a conclusively handled decision. No model, feature, admission, policy, entry-economics, portfolio, or exchange semantics changed.
execution_adjusted_ev: raw_expected_gross_bps - adverse_delay_gap_bps - max(80 bps, 1.2 * live_full_spread_bps + 2 * entry_impact_bps); raw_expected_gross_bps is the explicit MC1 gross convention and the historical 100-bps policy cost is not debited again; must remain at least +50 bps at preflight and after fill
position_monitor: persistent one-minute threshold monitor: stop/trailing/timeout use only post-fill closed 1m bars; the stored Adaptive Exit V1 activation is consumed by the minute executor and is never recomputed there; complete private liquidation-fill reconciliation is an exchange-close exception only
close_reporting: v42: close reports distinguish active policy thresholds, confirmed protective-stop fills, and externally confirmed liquidation fills. Fee-pending reports show confirmed gross PnL without claiming confirmed net PnL.

runtime_reseal_predecessors.reason: v59 differs from v58 only in close-report presentation. The v66 execution reseal retains v65 liquidation reconciliation and adds only the tested producer idempotency repair.
